svg.text: Double Agent Protocol: Puzzle Box Wiring (LilyPad Arduino 328)
VCC (3.3 V for testing, 5 V final)
LilyPad RGB boards (pads: −, R, G, B):
− pad → GND, one colour pad → resistor → pin
Pin HIGH = LED ON. Unused pads: nothing.
Phase-indicator LEDs: 5 RGB LEDs on the box, NOT the sensors.
One lights up to tell the solver which sensor to use (charlieplexed, only one on at a time).
Each uses 2 pads: triangle side = R pad, bar side = − pad. Not connected to VCC or GND.
2.2 kΩ protects the pin; safe to keep at
Everything shares one supply (3.3 V first, then 5 V). All grounds common.
